values.note: Reservable online up to 365 days ahead and for the same day ('Reservations can be made for today'), or at 1-888-432-2267; DNR: 'Reservations are highly recommended for weekend camping.' DNR's camping page: '2-day minimum required for weekends from Memorial Day weekend to Labor Day.' Mini cabins must be booked a day ahead.

values.note: The booking site lists 64 campsites in Acorn and Beechnut loops (8 electric, 56 non-electric of which 18 are tent-only) plus 3 mini cabins; RV/trailer sites list a 20- or 30-ft max vehicle length (31 take 30 ft). DNR's camping page says 69 sites, six electric, and six camper cabins.

April 16, 2027-October 30, 2027') + https://dnr.maryland.gov/publiclands/Pages/central/Susquehanna/Camping.aspx, read 2026-10-21

summary: Confirmed on DNR's Susquehanna camping page and the booking site: reservable 365 days ahead and same day, weekend 2-night minimum Memorial Day-Labor Day (left inherited so the holiday rule stays; this park's pages don't state it); 30-amp electric at 8 sites, 64 campsites to 30 ft; showers, water spigots, dump, park store; season mid-April (booking site) or May (DNR) to the last weekend of October. Fees (human-checked) match the current $21.50/$27.50. Not stated: same-day cutoff time, FCFS.
flags: Non-resident surcharge: DNR's 'Susquehanna State Park Campground Information' sheet (dated 10/22) says 'Weekends, add $1 /night; Out-of-State Residents, add $1 /night' (https://dnr.maryland.gov/publiclands/Documents/Susquehanna_CampInformation.pdf), but the entry's manual fees note says 'no out-of-state camping surcharge'. The sheet's prices are old ($27.75/$33.75, against today's $21.50/$27.50), so the surcharge may also be stale; not edited.

Phone: entry has 410-734-9035; DNR's park page and the booking site give 410-557-7994 (administrative office for Rocks, Susquehanna & Palmer State Parks); the 2022 campground sheet also lists a Campground Office at 410-914-4546.
Website: the entry's website is the booking page only; DNR's camping page is https://dnr.maryland.gov/publiclands/Pages/central/Susquehanna/Camping.aspx.
Senior discount: DNR says 'Senior citizens with a Golden Age Pass receive discounts Sunday through Thursday'; no discounts field holds it.
